name: Tata Chemicals Ltd
title: Tata Chemicals Ltd - 500770 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA fell to INR 274 crores from 327 crores on soda ash price weakness, with a INR 1,837 crore US goodwill impairment; supply exits are real but early, and China inventory sits near 1.8 million tons.

capex.peers_comment: Mothballing in US and maintenance closures in China noted; no peer capex discussed beyond that.
capex.quote: our capex for the soda ash business is going to be only when the cycle returns

triggers.label: US 1.36 Mt plant mothballed
triggers.quote: one of the producers with 1.36 million tons capacity has also mothballed its plant

triggers.label: Chinese output cut, permit expiry at 800kt plant
triggers.quote: One unit, which is about 800,000 tons Hubli plant, sort of had an expiration of production permit

triggers.label: Imports halved from 70-100kt/month
triggers.quote: that has reduced to half right now

triggers.label: China soda ash inventory ~1.8 Mt
triggers.quote: The inventories are close to 1.8 million tons, but it's been stable.

triggers.label: SE Asia prices unremunerative
triggers.quote: This resulted in Southeast Asia prices remaining unremunerative, especially for the US producers.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~INR 1,300 cr; debt flat
triggers.quote: Around INR 1,300 crores capex for next year, Arjun.

guidance.quote: Around INR 1,300 crores capex for next year, Arjun.
we expect the debt to remain overall at similar levels

red_flags.label: INR 1,837 cr goodwill impairment and INR 159 cr deferred tax write-off
red_flags.quote: An exceptional charge of INR 1,837 crores is provided on account of impairment of goodwill in US

red_flags.label: Kenya HFO supply ~40-45 days cover
red_flags.quote: they've got about 40 days of supply

evasions.quote: The next call we'll update you watching all of people.
